compliance.title: Product safety in the EU
compliance.p1: Safety Gate publishes alerts about dangerous non-food products. The General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) covers consumer products sold in the EU.
compliance.p2: Requirements depend on the product and country.
compliance.p3: The app provides evidence for review. It does not make legal assessments or change your products.
compliance.marketNote: Language does not determine the applicable law. Check the authority for the market where you sell.
compliance.remedies: For a safety recall, GPSR Article 37 requires an effective, free and timely remedy, normally a choice of at least two of repair, replacement or refund. National rules determine sanctions; requirements vary by product and sales market.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: The EU alert system for dangerous non-food products, formerly RAPEX. It covers products such as toys, electronics and cosmetics.
faq.a2: New alerts appear every week. After installation, we compare them with your products.
faq.q3: Does the app change my products?
faq.a3: No. It shows possible matches and evidence in Shopify Admin. You decide what to do.
faq.q4: What is included in the free scan?
faq.a4: All products available in your store’s public Shopify catalog and an emailed summary of possible matches. Private listings are excluded; the scan is not a safety certificate.
faq.q5: What if no possible matches are found?
faq.a5: Your report will show the number of checked products and that no possible matches were found in this check. This does not certify product safety. New alerts can appear later.
faq.q6: Does a possible match prove that my product is dangerous?
faq.a6: No. AI or an identifier can connect your listing to a Safety Gate record, but you still need to verify the exact product, model and affected batch. ZeroRecall supports your review; it does not certify safety or replace your legal obligations.

scan.detailsSummary: What exactly do we check during the free scan?
scan.detailsStep1: Public Shopify catalog: We read publicly available titles, descriptions, brands, categories and product photos from your store’s public storefront (without admin access).
scan.detailsStep2: Text and image comparison with Safety Gate: We turn text and images into search vectors and compare them against the entire EU Safety Gate (formerly RAPEX) database, including items listed under a different retail name.
scan.detailsStep3: Email summary and CSV export: When finished, you receive an email summary of possible matches with case numbers, links to official EU records and a downloadable CSV for your review.

privacy.content03: What we process for free scans and the Shopify app, and how long we keep it.
privacy.content04: Updated: 19 October 2026. We are an independent project. Privacy questions and requests: info@zerorecall.online.
privacy.content06:
• Free scan request: store domain, your email, language, request status and report. Your email confirms the request and receives the report.
  • Public catalog scan: public product titles, descriptions, brands, categories, images and URLs. We may also collect the business email on public contact pages. Product text becomes search vectors for comparison with Safety Gate alerts.
  • Installed Shopify app: shop domain, product snapshots and images, check results, possible matches, review decisions, settings, notification preferences and required app session data.
  • Technical records: security and service logs for operation, troubleshooting and protection.
privacy.content07: Why and how we use it
privacy.content08: We verify and run scans, compare public products with European Commission Safety Gate alerts and send reports. For installed stores, we run ongoing checks and keep review history. We also prevent abuse and maintain reliable service.
privacy.content09: We may store public business emails and scan summaries in an internal lead list to assess and manage potential app customers. This email is not needed to send your report. Possible matches support human review, not legal or product-safety determinations.
privacy.content11:
• Free scan request and report record: scheduled for deletion 30 days after the request.
  • Rate-limit and daily usage records: scheduled for deletion after 2 days.
  • Public scan catalog snapshot and search vectors: scheduled for deletion 90 days after saving or refreshing each record. Later scans restart the timer for reused records.
  • Shopify safety-check history: kept for 90 days. Alerts, decisions and audit history remain while the app is installed. After uninstall, Shopify's shop/redact request triggers deletion of app data and stored sessions.
  • Service logs and email-provider records: retained according to the retention settings and policies of Google Cloud and Brevo.
privacy.content12: Cloud database expiration policies handle deletion. Google Cloud may remove expired records after the stated deadline.
privacy.content14: Shopify runs the embedded app. Google Cloud and Firebase provide hosting, storage, background jobs and Vertex AI product comparison. Brevo sends confirmation, report and notification emails. Cloudflare Turnstile protects the free-scan form from automated abuse.
privacy.content15: Alerts come from the European Commission's public Safety Gate system. Providers process information as needed to deliver these services.
privacy.content17: Email info@zerorecall.online to request access, correction or deletion of your scan or store data, or to object to processing.
privacy.content18: After uninstall, Shopify sends a shop/redact request to delete the store's app data. We acknowledge Shopify customer-data requests; we do not store customer accounts or orders.

ai.title: A different name. A familiar product.
ai.body: Suppliers change titles. Listings lose model numbers. ZeroRecall uses AI to compare product details and photos with official EU Safety Gate records, helping you spot possible matches that an exact text search can miss.
ai.exactTitle: EAN first. More evidence when it is missing.
ai.exactBody: An exact EAN / GTIN match is the strongest signal of product identity. When identifiers are incomplete, AI weighs the brand, model, description and distinctive visual details together. A shared category alone is not enough.
ai.visualTitle: Photos add context that a title cannot.
ai.visualBody: Similar construction, packaging or visible model markings can help connect differently named listings. Conflicting identifiers and missing evidence matter too: an uncertain match stays a question for review.
ai.exampleTitle: See a possible match become a decision
ai.missing: EAN and model missing from the listing
ai.detailTitle: What the AI would flag for review
ai.detailBody: In this illustration: a similar frame, steering joint and wheel design. These details support a possible match; they do not confirm the exact model or affected batch.
ai.reviewBody: Compare the listing and official alert, then verify the model and batch with your supplier. In the installed app, record a resolution, dismiss a different product, or keep the finding open while waiting for the supplier.
ai.record: Review decisions are saved with an actor, time and note in the app.
ai.limit: AI suggests possible matches. It does not certify safety or replace your review. This example is illustrative; it is not a real recall or a live scan.

features.title: What your store gets with ZeroRecall
features.body: The installed app brings catalog checks, ongoing monitoring and documented decisions into one Shopify workflow. An active plan enables ongoing monitoring; the public free scan is a separate one-off check.
features.catalogTitle: A first check across your catalog
features.catalogBody: Import your Shopify catalog and compare it with indexed Safety Gate history. Follow progress and see which current product versions have a saved check.
features.monitorTitle: Monitoring that keeps working in the background
features.monitorBody: New Safety Gate alerts and Shopify product changes trigger background checks, even when Shopify Admin is closed.
features.aiTitle: EAN, product details and photo comparison
features.aiBody: Prioritize exact EAN / GTIN matches. Use AI to assess likely matches from brands, models, descriptions and photos when identifiers are incomplete.
features.productBody: Search for one product, run a manual check or view its latest Safety Gate status and request a check directly from the Shopify product page.
features.reviewTitle: A review queue with clear outcomes
features.reviewBody: Compare the evidence, dismiss a different product, record action taken or keep a finding open while waiting for your supplier. Review photo galleries and links to official alerts.
features.bulkTitle: Bulk decisions for a busy catalog
features.bulkBody: Resolve or dismiss multiple findings together. Keep notes and decision history without repeating the same review action for every row.
features.emailBody: Get an immediate email for a newly created finding and a weekly summary when there are no new findings. Choose the recipient, language and notification preferences.
features.auditTitle: A record of checks and decisions
features.auditBody: Keep review outcomes with an actor, timestamp and notes. View decision history and export checks and decisions in a CSV report.
features.languageBody: Choose your working language in the app and your notification language for email. Original product identifiers and official source facts stay intact.
features.control: Your catalog stays under your control. Recording a review decision does not automatically unpublish or change a Shopify product.

notice.title: The alert comes to you
notice.body: When a new finding is created, ZeroRecall can email the product, Safety Gate comparison and a link to review it in your Shopify app. You do not have to keep the app open to receive the notification.
notice.whatTitle: A clear next step, not just a warning
notice.whatBody: Open the finding, compare the photos and identifiers, then verify the model and batch before deciding. Your notification recipient, language and preferences are editable in Settings.
notice.weeklyTitle: No new findings? You still get an update.
notice.weeklyBody: With weekly summaries enabled, a week without new findings brings a summary. Existing open findings can still need your attention; an incomplete monitoring run is shown as incomplete.
notice.previewNote: Example content and illustration, not a real alert or a sent email. The preview button opens the walkthrough below; a real email links to your shop's authenticated review page.
notice.imageCaption: Illustrative product image, not an official Safety Gate photograph
notice.subject: We found a possible match with an EU Safety Gate alert.
notice.instruction: Compare the model, brand and batch with the official record. Save your decision and a note in the app.

start.title: What happens after you install
start.body: From the first catalog check to ongoing monitoring, you can see what is running and which findings need a decision.
start.step1Title: Connect your store and choose a plan
start.step1Body: Install through Shopify, approve product-read access and choose a plan to activate ongoing monitoring. Set your email recipient and notification language.
start.step2Title: Let the first catalog audit run
start.step2Body: ZeroRecall imports your products and checks indexed Safety Gate history in the background. Follow progress in the app; larger catalogs take longer. An import alone is not a completed safety check.
start.step3Body: Possible matches enter your review queue. Compare the official record with your product and save a decision or keep the finding open while waiting for your supplier.
start.step4Body: New Safety Gate alerts and product updates trigger checks while your plan is active. Newly created findings can trigger an email, and your decisions remain in the review history.
start.matchBody: This is a request to review the evidence, not proof that your exact model or batch is dangerous. Confirm those details before taking action.
start.clearBody: The completed check found no possible match in the indexed records it checked. This is not a safety certificate. New alerts and product changes can change the result later.
start.audienceTitle: For stores selling physical products in the EU
start.audienceBody: Especially useful for toys, baby products, electronics, cosmetics, home goods and imported or white-label products. AI photo comparison can help when supplier listings have incomplete identifiers. Safety Gate covers dangerous non-food products.
start.caseTitle: Example: a changed title, then a supplier check
start.caseBody: Illustrative scenario: a supplier lists a balance bike under a different name and omits the model. Visual details lead to a possible match. The merchant compares the alert and requests the model and batch from the supplier. If the evidence shows a different product, they dismiss the finding with a note; if it confirms the affected product, they take the appropriate action and record it. This is a workflow example, not a customer case or a live result.
